static_traits.name: Gu Rui
static_traits.family_status: Liking to cook for family and friends; having a supportive network of relatives and friends
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends affected by Withdrawal and self-isolation when intimate relationship topics arise; overall Has a supportive network of family and friends, but has not yet deeply shared real feelings
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; never received treatment for psychological problems before; never had similar problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to cooperate in exploration; Low mood with frequent absolutist/catastrophic statements (e.g., 'my romantic future is completely gone'); shows Withdrawal on social topics

basic_info.main_problem: I still love my ex-boyfriend; his recent marriage makes me believe my romantic future is completely gone.
basic_info.core_demands: Feeling strong despair about my romantic prospects due to my ex-boyfriend's recent marriage, hoping for support and guidance.
growth_experiences: Six months ago, my ex-boyfriend got married. Since then the client has felt heartbroken and abandoned, believing her romantic future is 'completely gone', and repeatedly experiencing hopelessness and Loneliness when Being alone or when relationships are discussed in Social situations. The client tried distracting through Work, hobbies and socializing, but related thoughts persist, affecting sleep, self-care, Work performance and Interpersonal relationships.

core_beliefs: I cannot possibly find happiness in love
My romantic future is completely gone

special_situations.event: Learning my ex-boyfriend got married six months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If an important intimate partner has already entered marriage, it means I lose the possibility of love
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses work, hobbies, and socializing to distract attention
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My romantic future is completely gone / I will never find love again

special_situations.event: Others discussing romance or marriage topics in Social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not have a stable relationship like others, it means I am a failure and something is wrong with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids related topics, withdraws and keeps distance from friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They all have happy relationships; only I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Thinking about my ex-boyfriend having moved on with his life when Being alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he has moved on while I remain stagnant, it means my future is destined to be lonely
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immersed in repeated thinking, while trying to suppress emotions through work and hobbies
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be lonely forever; I will never find love again

special_situations.event: Thinking about the fact of my ex-boyfriend 'moving on and getting married'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he chose someone else and got married, it means I am not good enough / not worthy of being loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not revealing inner feelings to friends and family to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It must be my fault that he left me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be loved and to gain a stable intimate commitment
core_conflict.fear: Fears being abandoned again; fears hope shattering and heartbreak repeating
defense_goal: Avoids being hurt again through retreat and self-isolation
Repressing real feelings to maintain surface stability

object_relations.object_representation: An abandoner / rejecter who has walked away

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When intimate relationships come up in social settings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes others are all settled while they are excluded; if they express themselves they will appear to be a failure (transference: self-derogation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a self-blaming tone, lowering volume, avoiding eye contact; using self-critical phrases like 'it is all because I am not good enough', reducing interaction with the other.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about or seeing my ex-boyfriend's marriage and current situation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Taking the other person's choice as negation of one's own value (transference: Ingestion/introjection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing with a generalizing judgment 'this shows I am not worthy of being loved', ignoring complex background, in a heavy tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited or asked whether she shares inner feelings with relatives and friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that expressing herself will intensify pain or be misunderstood, so she chooses to endure in silence
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Politely displacing the topic, emphasizing 'I am fine', reducing emotional words, maintaining a calm tone.

manifestations: Feeling intense heartbreak and abandonment when Being alone
Feeling in Social situations that 'everyone else has it figured out, only I do not'
Retreat and self-isolation, not yet deeply sharing real feelings with friends and family
Believing 'my romantic future is completely gone'
Repeatedly ruminating 'I cannot possibly be happy in love'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Self-reproach: e.g., 'maybe I am naturally not suited for happy love'
Excessively concerned in social topics about appearing like a failure

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Trying to distract from heartbreak and Loneliness with Work, hobbies and socializing
When asked about feelings, more inclined to talk about actions or facts rather than emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual separates painful emotions from related events or suppresses them, not expressing them.
manifestations: Not yet deeply sharing real emotions and pain about my ex-boyfriend with friends and family

positive_force: Has a supportive network of family and friends
Able to actively seek counseling and help
Able to identify that 'reality and the narrative in my head do not match' and willing to practice alternative perspectives
Has behavioral resources to self-regulate through work and hobbies
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent
Personalizing the other person's choice as negation of self-worth (personalization)

antecedent: Others discussing romance or marriage topics in Social gatherings

target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome emotions and possible judgment, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged friendships, worsened Loneliness, negative thought cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated catastrophic thinking 'I will never find love again', causing Difficulty falling asleep
antecedent: Thinking about or seeing my ex-boyfriend's marriage and current situation
target_behavior.core_reason: Ruminative thinking triggered by black-and-white thinking and predicting the future
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain certainty through thinking, but actually reinforcing Anxiety and hopelessness
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality, daytime energy and Work performance affected
